newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Volume picks up on Abidjan bourse.
newsitem.headline: Volume picks up on Abidjan bourse.

text.p: Trade picked up on Ivory Coast's stock exchange, the Bourse des Valeurs d'Abidjan (BVA), in the week to Friday, boosted by the return of traders from August holidays, the market report showed.
The BVA All-Share Index fell by 0.55 percent to 354.31 points from 356.29 the previous week, taking the 1996 rise to 27.79 percent.
The 12VB 12-share index rose 0.02 percent to 241.13 points from 241.07, taking the 1996 rise to 21.01 percent.
Volume rose more than fourfold to 254,228,000 CFA francs from 56,025,000 CFA and the number of shares traded rose to 21,100 from 2,390 from 1,583.
Water utility SODECI made a one-for-three share issue following a capital increase. Consequently, its shares fell by 5,440 CFA to 16,560 CFA.
Transport and freight company SAGA-CI was the biggest gainer, rising 950 CFA to 19,030.
